about: Tracker declaration of the fixed account application, read by scripts/check-privacy.mjs. Only the entries of "exempt" may be present before consent. The third parties listed with "exempt": false run only after consent through the reference consent loader.

exempt.name: eu-consent
exempt.justification: Set by the reference consent banner. Stores only the visitor's choice per purpose, its date and the banner version; no identifier.

exempt.name: __Host-sid
exempt.justification: Session cookie set at sign-in (simulated by the .headers file). Strictly necessary for the account the member asked for; HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax.
